$comment: CRISSP: the parts of {{PRODUCT}}: what every run, crissp/check.sh's map and the dashboard are made of. By default the backend is app/backend, the frontend app/frontend, and docker-compose.yml at the root runs them together; a step exists once its part does (`when`); a parallel step spreads its tests over the workers this machine has. crissp/testsuite/lib/project.py says what each field means; python3 crissp/testsuite/lib/project.py check says what is wrong.
